title: Tanker With 21 Indian Seafarers Struck by Unidentified Projectile in Strait of Hormuz
detail: A news report published Oct 22 says an oil tanker carrying 21 Indian seafarers was hit by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz and that all crew are safe. Only the aggregated headline was available; the vessel, flag, exact location, attacker and damage were not verified, so the report is unconfirmed.

title: Iran Reports Seven Tankers Damaged in Hormuz in 24 Hours; Traffic Falls
detail: A news report published Oct 22 says Iran reported damage to seven oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz within 24 hours, including four attacked simultaneously, and that tanker traffic through the strait fell amid fears of renewed US-Iran war. Only the aggregated headline was available; vessels, attackers and damage were not independently verified, so the report is unconfirmed.
